cases.title: Bank account opening
cases.who: A bank's authorised official verifies an applicant.
cases.risk: Impersonation and mismatched identity evidence are risks addressed by the required checks.
cases.possibility: Local capture feedback could surface recapture issues before officer review.
cases.boundary: HumanAuth does not perform bank CDD, issuer verification, geolocation or regulated recording.

cases.title: Bank re-verification
cases.who: A bank verifies an existing customer's updated details.
cases.risk: Customers may need another branch or video interaction when records need updating.
cases.possibility: Study a local repeat-match step during a consented branch visit.
cases.boundary: A local match cannot replace the bank's official Re-KYC or authorise a payment.

cases.title: Pension life certificates
cases.who: The pension service authenticates a pensioner for a digital life certificate.
cases.risk: Physical submission and worn fingerprints can create access barriers.
cases.possibility: Study assisted, same-device re-identification at a service desk.
cases.boundary: This demo cannot issue a life certificate or decide pension eligibility.

cases.title: Welfare and ration counters
cases.who: An authorised service agency authenticates its beneficiary.
cases.risk: Worn or missing fingerprints need an alternative verification route.
cases.possibility: Explore a voluntary local repeat-check with an attendant fallback.
cases.boundary: The demo does not connect to Aadhaar or establish entitlement; a research failure must not deny benefits.

cases.title: Citizen document checks
cases.who: A requester verifies documents supplied by an authorised issuer.
cases.risk: An uploaded scan and an issuer-signed document have different provenance.
cases.possibility: Show how a visual tampering signal differs from issuer validation.
cases.boundary: A classifier score cannot establish an issuer's signature or a document's legal validity.

cases.title: Securities-account KYC
cases.who: A registered intermediary verifies an investor.
cases.risk: Digital onboarding needs evidence and live-presence checks, not just a form.
cases.possibility: Study clear recapture and review reasons before submission.
cases.boundary: The SEBI FAQ is workflow context; HumanAuth is not an intermediary or KRA integration.

cases.title: Insurance video identification
cases.who: An insurer or authorised person verifies a customer or beneficiary.
cases.risk: Recorded or mismatched identity material is a risk the video workflow addresses.
cases.possibility: Explore local checks that explain why an image or capture needs review.
cases.boundary: The insurer retains responsibility; its VBIP retention and review workflow is not implemented here.

cases.title: NPS subscriber onboarding
cases.who: A reporting entity verifies an NPS subscriber.
cases.risk: Expression-based challenges can exclude subscribers with disabilities.
cases.possibility: Study assisted review and an explicit alternative path.
cases.boundary: PFRDA's modes and records are distinct from this demo; no NPS registration is created.

cases.title: SIM issuance and replacement
cases.who: A telecom provider's authorised point of sale verifies a subscriber.
cases.risk: Printed photos, mismatched portraits and manual form errors are addressed in DoT instructions.
cases.possibility: Study local live-capture prompts before an authorised provider's checks.
cases.boundary: This is not a telecom KYC app and cannot activate a connection.

cases.title: Campus and office-style entry
cases.who: Campus security checks a member or visitor; an office is a proposed analogous setting.
cases.risk: A photo of an ID on a phone may be presented where a physical card is expected.
cases.possibility: Study repeat recognition on an attendant's device after authorised enrollment.
cases.boundary: An access badge or visitor pass may be simpler; no institution uses HumanAuth.

cases.title: Exam-centre candidate verification
cases.who: Exam-centre staff verify a registered candidate.
cases.risk: Entry verification must distinguish the candidate from an impersonator.
cases.possibility: Study an assisted mismatch explanation and review queue.
cases.boundary: The NTA tender is a procurement specification; it is not proof of deployment at every centre or an endorsement.

cases.title: Driver and delivery onboarding
cases.who: A platform checks that its worker matches the screened account.
cases.risk: Account sharing and photographing a photo are explicitly listed failure cases.
cases.possibility: Study a repeat local match without repeatedly retaining raw captures.
cases.boundary: Background screening and platform account control remain separate; the cited example is Uber's driver policy.

cases.title: Telemedicine identification
cases.who: A practitioner and patient establish each other's identity.
cases.risk: Anonymous or mistaken identity is unsafe; one fixed modality is not prescribed for every consultation.
cases.possibility: Study optional pre-consultation repeat matching with staff assistance.
cases.boundary: No diagnosis, medical identity or access-to-care decision is made by this demo.

cases.title: Hotel check-in
cases.who: Hotel staff compare the guest, reservation and photo ID.
cases.risk: A booking reference alone may not meet a property's check-in identity policy.
cases.possibility: Explore a consented same-stay repeat check at an attended desk.
cases.boundary: This example is one Indian hotel's policy, not a nationwide biometric requirement.

cases.title: Airport journeys
cases.who: An authorised travel workflow checks a passenger and journey credentials.
cases.risk: Repeated passenger and boarding-pass checks add touchpoints during a journey.
cases.possibility: Study a simulated attended gate with locally enrolled synthetic participants.
cases.boundary: Digi Yatra is a design reference; HumanAuth has no airport integration or boarding authority.

cases.title: Remote bank onboarding
cases.who: A digital bank checks a prospective customer's identity.
cases.risk: A branchless bank needs to link the applicant to the submitted ID.
cases.possibility: Study local capture quality and face-to-portrait consistency.
cases.boundary: Monzo's published workflow is an example; it is not a claim about HumanAuth or every bank.

cases.title: Call-centre voice authentication
cases.who: Telephone-banking staff authenticate an enrolled caller.
cases.risk: Repeated security questions create another verification step.
cases.possibility: Use a local speaker-verification study to measure impostor acceptance and rejection.
cases.boundary: NatWest's service does not validate this prototype. NIST authentication guidance separately excludes voice comparison.

cases.title: European identity wallets
cases.who: An issuer provisions credentials; a relying party checks a presentation.
cases.risk: Sharing an entire document can reveal more attributes than the transaction needs.
cases.possibility: Explore data minimisation without exporting biometric templates.
cases.boundary: The EUDI framework is not a claim of universal deployment or wallet interoperability here.

cases.title: Identity-proofing and authentication guidance
cases.who: A credential provider proves identity; a verifier authenticates a subscriber.
cases.risk: A biometric match alone does not bind a person to trusted identity evidence or a physical authenticator.
cases.possibility: Make proofing, later local matching and the limits of each explicit.
cases.boundary: This prototype implements no NIST assurance level or conformity claim.

entry_scenarios.title: Pension or welfare service desk
entry_scenarios.registers: A consenting visitor, assisted by staff, on the desk device after the normal official process.
entry_scenarios.verifies: An attendant re-identifies a locally enrolled visitor during the visit.
entry_scenarios.risk: Access barriers require alternatives to a failed biometric check.
entry_scenarios.proposal: Demonstrate a short local repeat-check, show reasons and allow staff review. Keep eligibility decisions outside the demo.

entry_scenarios.title: Office or campus gate
entry_scenarios.registers: An authorised staff member enrolls a consenting member on the gate device.
entry_scenarios.verifies: The attendant compares a returning participant with this device's registrations.
entry_scenarios.risk: Institutional ID and visitor-pass checks still need a trusted enrollment process.
entry_scenarios.proposal: Study same-device matching and a badge/manual fallback; no connected door lock.

entry_scenarios.title: Event entry
entry_scenarios.registers: An organiser enrolls volunteers at an attended registration desk.
entry_scenarios.verifies: An event attendant checks a returning participant.
entry_scenarios.risk: Copied ticket images can fail modern mobile-ticket checks.
entry_scenarios.proposal: Treat this as an optional study; encrypted tickets may solve entry with less biometric data.

entry_scenarios.title: Exam hall
entry_scenarios.registers: Authorised exam staff would bind a candidate to official records; this demo uses synthetic records only.
entry_scenarios.verifies: An attendant would review a match or exception at the hall.
entry_scenarios.risk: A false rejection can prevent a genuine candidate entering.
entry_scenarios.proposal: Demonstrate exception reasons and review; do not decide exam admission.

entry_scenarios.title: Hostel reception
entry_scenarios.registers: Hostel staff would enroll a consenting resident on reception's device.
entry_scenarios.verifies: The receptionist would check a returning resident or registered visitor.
entry_scenarios.risk: A local face match cannot replace the institution's visitor registration rules.
entry_scenarios.proposal: Explore repeat matching with expiry, per-person deletion and a register/card fallback.

entry_scenarios.title: Hospital patient re-identification
entry_scenarios.registers: A staff-assisted volunteer enrolls in a separate research session.
entry_scenarios.verifies: An attendant reviews the research match, separately from clinical care.
entry_scenarios.risk: Patient misidentification can cause harm; guidance calls for multiple identifiers and non-verbal alternatives.
entry_scenarios.proposal: Study an additional signal only. Never use the demo to deny treatment or replace clinical identification.

entry_scenarios.title: Airport-style self-boarding
entry_scenarios.registers: An authorised travel process binds a passenger to travel credentials; the demo enrolls synthetic participants.
entry_scenarios.verifies: A simulated gate checks local registrations.
entry_scenarios.risk: Passenger identity and journey eligibility are separate checks.
entry_scenarios.proposal: Use Digi Yatra as a sourced design reference, with no real boarding approval or integration.
